item.name: FLIPSIDE
item.label: Live event tool
item.description: Flipside is a browser-based game show controller for live audience quiz sessions, built to run from a laptop on a projector. A team picks a number, a prompt fills the screen, a ring timer counts down with sound, and the card flips in 3D to reveal the answer before the operator scores it. It is fully keyboard-driven, has no backend, and keeps questions and state in the browser.
